purpose: Route-grouped calibration/validation protocol for reproducing the already frozen native smartphone lanes on a small, device-diverse train cohort.

scope.inspection_before_freeze: ZIP central-directory names, sizes, CRC32, existing JSON/path metadata only; no archive member content was opened and no ground_truth.csv was read by Phase24 freeze.
scope.mat_policy: No .mat member is fetched, opened, generated, or used. MATLAB source is out of scope for this phase.

prior_truth_use_audit.classification: A prior positive truth counter, scored artifact, or materialized ground_truth path excludes that exact identity from the never-opened set. Existing development-train truth may be reused only as historical calibration evidence and is not called fresh validation.
notes: The repository contains historical materializations and records from prior phases; these are evidence for exclusion/history only.

frozen_split.selection_basis: Metadata-only required raw files and route broadcast navigation, route/year/device diversity, and role separation. No metric, truth residual, leaderboard score, sample coordinate, or precomputed trajectory ranked the split.
frozen_split.excluded_candidate_without_nav: 2021-12-07-19-22-us-ca-lax-d/mi8 has complete GNSS/IMU/truth central members but no route broadcast nav member, so it is not a native FGO candidate.
frozen_split.historical_route_overlap_warning: The three calibration identities are historical development evidence. No calibration route is reused by the fresh validation or future holdout roles; any prior phone on a selected route is recorded rather than silently treated as never-used.

control_phase12.parameters: Frozen Phase12 recipe; no changes in Phase24.

development_go_e1_e5a.parameters: Frozen Phase19 E1+E5a safe-Hatch contract; no changes in Phase24.

development_go_stop.parameters: Frozen Phase20 stop-constraint contract; no changes in Phase24.

development_go_position_offset.parameters: Frozen Phase21 position-offset contract; no changes in Phase24.

evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.truth_policy: Generate and seal raw-only artifacts for every candidate before opening the corresponding development truth. Truth is scoring-only and never enters the solver or candidate selection.
evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.route_grouping: All metrics are computed independently per route; no timestamps, state, residual, truth, or calibration crosses route boundaries.
metrics: horizontal P50/P95, vertical P95, availability, truth coverage
evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of route-level metrics, with route count and matched-key counts shown; no micro-average substitution.
evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.candidate_selection: No score-derived parameter fitting. Existing frozen lanes are compared as named recipes only; any failed lane is fail-closed and retained in the matrix.
evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.train_gate: Every candidate must be finite, deterministic, complete, and physically continuous, then non-regress all four diagnostics and horizontal/vertical/coverage metrics against Phase12 per route and in aggregate. A strict aggregate improvement in at least one primary metric is required for a train pass.
evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.validation_gate: Open the frozen validation truth once only if all unchanged train gates pass; require all four diagnostics and aggregate improvement, availability/coverage non-regression, and vertical/continuity safety.
evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.holdout_gate: The future holdout remains sealed regardless of train/validation outcome; no Phase24 holdout access is authorized.
evaluation_protocol_frozen_before_truth.post_score: No candidate, parameter, split, or evaluator change after any truth score.

commands_planned.metadata_audit: python3 <Phase24 metadata-only inventory command>; use ZIP central directory and JSON/path metadata only
commands_planned.score: Only after raw artifacts and manifests are hash-sealed: one route-group evaluator process reads the declared train truth files and scores all frozen candidates together.
commands_planned.validation: Not permitted until the unchanged train gate passes; one process/open maximum for the frozen validation truth.

integrity.freeze_record_hash: computed after this JSON is committed; stored only in the companion manifest
